source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: The Bladeguard may choose once per turn in the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), either on being **selected to fight** or on being targeted by an enemy unit. Their melee **hit rolls** get +1, or the attacker takes −1 to **hit rolls** against the Bladeguard.
